_readme: Copy to config.json and fill in — local runs only. Tokens stay on your machine: config.json is git-ignored. On Vercel, set the same values as environment variables instead (META_TOKEN, FB_PAGE_ID, FB_PAGE_TOKEN, IG_USER_ID, LI_ORG_URN, LI_TOKEN). Get a token: developers.facebook.com → your app → Graph API Explorer → Generate Access Token.
